events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Liam Gallagher, the iconic frontman of Oasis and a successful solo artist, was born on September 21, 1972.

angles.name: Rock 'n' Roll Star
angles.copy: Happy 54th birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! What's your favourite Oasis anthem or solo track from the man himself?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' album released
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic album 'Imagine' was released on October 1, 1975.

angles.name: Imagine 51st Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-one years ago today, John Lennon released his timeless album 'Imagine'. A powerful message that still resonates.

events.title: Apple launched the first iPod
events.blurb: The original Apple iPod, which revolutionised portable music, was first introduced on October 3, 2001.

angles.name: iPod Nostalgia
angles.copy: Remember when the first iPod dropped 25 years ago today? Suddenly, 1,000 songs in your pocket was mind-blowing. How many did you have?

events.title: Global James Bond Day
events.blurb: Global James Bond Day is celebrated annually on October 5th, marking the 1962 premiere of the very first Bond film, 'Dr. No'.

angles.name: Shaken, Not Stirred
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! From Sean Connery's debut in 'Dr. No' back in '62 to the latest blockbusters, who's your favourite 007 and why?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Legendary Beatles co-founder John Lennon was born on October 9, 1940.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we're remembering the incredible legacy of John Lennon. Which of his songs means the most to you?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The acclaimed English actor, comedian, and writer John Cleese, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday on October 27, 1939.

angles.name: And Now For Something Completely Different
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the legendary John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty Towers, what's your favourite moment of his comedic genius?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' released
events.blurb: The Beatles' iconic double album, officially titled 'The Beatles' but widely known as the 'White Album', was released on November 2, 1968.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: On this day in 1968, The Beatles unleashed the 'White Album'. A sprawling masterpiece – what's your standout track from this incredible record?

events.title: Anniversary of Freddie Mercury's death
events.blurb: The music world remembers Freddie Mercury, who tragically passed away on November 24, 1991, at the age of 45.

angles.name: Remembering Freddie
angles.copy: Thirty-five years since we lost the incomparable Freddie Mercury. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched. What's your favourite Queen song?

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' released
events.blurb: The Beatles' influential album 'Rubber Soul' was released on December 3, 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-one years ago today, The Beatles released 'Rubber Soul'. Widely considered a pivotal album, what makes it special for you?

events.title: Anniversary of John Lennon's death
events.blurb: The music world marks the anniversary of the tragic passing of John Lennon on December 8, 1980.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: On the anniversary of his untimely death, we take a moment to reflect on the life and enduring music of John Lennon. His legacy lives on.
